rules.statement: The owners of undivided shares can make arrangements among themselves as to the enjoyment of the produce of the land, and evidence showing that a co-owner has enjoyed the fruits of certain trees would support his title to an undivided share.
rules.supporting_quote: It is competent for the owners of undivided shares of a land to make arrangements among themselves as to the enjoyment of the produce of the land; and evidence showing that any one co-owner has enjoyed the fruits of a certain number of trees in pursuance of such arrangement would go to support his title to an undivided share of the land.
